description: Source code implementing an alternative malloc memory allocator based on dlmalloc, supporting multi-threaded environments with lock contention mitigation, including thread cache management and custom memory space handling.

classes.name: threadcacheblk
classes.description: Structure representing a memory block in thread cache, with size and usage metadata.

classes.name: threadcache
classes.description: Structure managing thread-local cache of memory blocks for fast allocation and deallocation.

classes.name: nedpool
classes.description: Structure representing a pool of memory spaces with thread caches and synchronization primitives.

methods.name: size2binidx
methods.description: Calculates the bin index for a given size, used for thread cache binning.

methods.name: nedblksize
methods.description: Returns the size of a memory block given a pointer to the allocated memory.

methods.name: nedsetvalue
methods.description: Sets a user-defined value associated with a memory pool.

methods.name: nedmalloc
methods.description: Allocates memory of specified size from the default or provided pool.

methods.name: nedcalloc
methods.description: Allocates zero-initialized memory for an array of elements.

methods.name: nedrealloc
methods.description: Reallocates a memory block to a new size.

methods.name: nedfree
methods.description: Frees a previously allocated memory block.

methods.name: nedmemalign
methods.description: Allocates memory with specified alignment.

methods.name: nedmallinfo
methods.description: Returns memory allocation statistics.

methods.name: nedmallopt
methods.description: Adjusts memory allocator parameters.

methods.name: nedmalloc_trim
methods.description: Trims unused memory from the allocator.

methods.name: nedmalloc_stats
methods.description: Prints allocator statistics.

methods.name: nedmalloc_footprint
methods.description: Returns total memory footprint.

methods.name: nedindependent_calloc
methods.description: Allocates multiple blocks with independent sizes.

methods.name: nedindependent_comalloc
methods.description: Allocates multiple blocks with specified sizes.

methods.name: nedcreatepool
methods.description: Creates a new memory pool with specified capacity and thread count.

methods.name: neddestroypool
methods.description: Destroys a memory pool and frees associated resources.

methods.name: nedpsetvalue
methods.description: Associates a user value with a specific pool.

methods.name: nedgetvalue
methods.description: Retrieves the user value associated with a memory block's pool.

methods.name: neddisablethreadcache
methods.description: Disables thread cache for the current thread, freeing cached blocks.
